summary: Iteration 910 — Frontend retest of iteration_909 fixes for free user (p1.free.1779113329@example.com). CONFIRMED FIXES: (a) Free-user main dashboard renders correctly — tv-v2-kpi-countries='Countries30', kpi-categories='Categories480', kpi-plan='Planfree', 25 flagcdn img tags, region-filter/Top-Countries/Trending-Destinations all populated (previous iter_909 'blank main dashboard' was a side-effect of onboarding never completing — see BUG #1). (b) Onboarding step transitions Step1→Step2→Step3 confirmed via header text once click-interception was worked around (see BUG #1). (c) Embassies tab (tv-v2-tab-embassy) shows 12 flag imgs; Interview Sim tab (tv-v2-tab-interview) shows 15 flag imgs including AU/BR/CA/CN/FR/DE/IN/IE/IT/JP/MY/MX. (d) Mobile 390x844: single column, no horizontal overflow (dw=390, cw=390), 25 flag imgs visible. UNRESOLVED / NEW BUGS: (1) CRITICAL — free-user fixed-bottom feature-quota-pill overlay ('5 free actions left today') intercepts pointer events on the onboarding Continue button (tv-v2-onboarding-continue at y≈1798); Playwright errors confirm the pill's subtree steals the click. Real free users likely also cannot advance the onboarding on smaller viewports where the pill sits over the Continue button. Test only succeeded after force-hiding [data-testid=feature-quota-pill] via JS. (2) HIGH — iter_909 step-3 level-cards visibility fix NOT SUFFICIENT: after step 2 Continue is clicked (which scrolls window to y≈782 to bring Continue into view), stepping into experience renders levels at y=-452 (above viewport). window.scrollTo(0,0) does NOT reset because the ScrollView is an inner scroller. Level cards are in DOM (present=true) but visually above viewport — matches iter_909's LOW-priority ScrollView complaint but is actually still broken. (3) HIGH — theme-toggle NOT reachable on /features/travel-visa: query for [data-testid=theme-toggle-dark] returns null on this route even after onboarding closes. AppShell sidebar (which contains theme-toggle) does not render on the Travel Visa route — dark-mode QA remains blocked from this route.

ui_bugs.issue: Fixed-position quota pill ('5 free actions left today') at bottom of viewport intercepts pointer events targeting tv-v2-onboarding-continue. Playwright fails with 'feature-quota-pill / feature-quota-pill-label subtree intercepts pointer events'. Real free users experience Continue button unclickable when it lines up with the pill (small viewports, or after scroll-to-Continue). Verified reproduction: free user @1920x1080 after choosing US.

After clicking Continue on step 2 (which scrolls the outer window to bring Continue into view at y~1798), transitioning to step 3 does NOT reset the ScrollView / window scroll position. Level cards render at getBoundingClientRect().y = -452 (above visible viewport). Cards ARE in DOM but user sees a blank page. iter_909's fix (contentContainerStyle={flexGrow:1,padding}) did not solve this — the root cause is missing scroll-reset on step transition, not layout height.

The Travel Visa route renders full-width without the AppShell sidebar (verified in screenshots — no sidebar-nav-*, no theme-toggle in DOM). Even after onboarding overlay closes, [data-testid=theme-toggle-dark] returns null. Contrary to the request note that theme-toggle exists at app-shell — it exists but not on this route.

integration_issues.issue: Combined effect of BUG #1 (quota-pill click interception) + BUG #2 (step-3 scroll not reset) means a real free user (a) cannot click Continue on step 1/2/3 if the button aligns with the quota pill, and (b) even if they do, step-3 content is scrolled above viewport. Only workaround for QA is JS-hiding the pill AND scrolling.

issues: The Travel Visa route does not use the AppShell chrome (no sidebar, no theme-toggle, no notifications bell) — this creates an inconsistent UX vs other feature routes and makes dark-mode/theming inaccessible from within Travel Visa.

action_items: URGENT: Fix pointer-event interception between feature-quota-pill and the onboarding overlay. Options: (a) set feature-quota-pill's zIndex lower than tv-v2-onboarding-root, OR (b) add pointerEvents:'none' on the pill's wrapper except on its close button, OR (c) hide feature-quota-pill (display:none) while tv-v2-onboarding-overlay is mounted (best UX — mirror the Suggested-AI-specialists panel behavior).

URGENT: On step transition inside TravelVisaOnboarding, RESET the scroll position of the outer ScrollView back to y=0. Recommended: attach a ref to <ScrollView ref={scrollRef}> and call scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({y:0, animated:false}) inside a useEffect keyed on currentStep. Also reset window.scrollY on web (Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.scrollTo(0,0) : null).

Add theme-toggle (or a fallback data-testid) to the TravelVisa header, OR wrap the Travel Visa route inside the AppShell so the sidebar theme-toggle is reachable from /features/travel-visa. Currently dark-mode QA on this route is impossible via a stable selector.

OPTIONAL: Add data-testid="tv-v2-country-{iso}" on Top Countries cards and tv-v2-trending-{iso} on Trending pills — currently returned 0 for both prefix queries even though ~15 country cards + 9 trending pills render (visible in screenshots), so future E2E can assert per-country presence.

OPTIONAL: Add data-testid="tv-embassy-country-{iso}" on the embassy filter chips and tv-sim-country-{iso} on interview country chips — currently the chips render with flags but no per-chip testid was found (chip_count=0).
critical_code_review_comments: TravelVisaOnboarding.tsx: State-managed step transitions do NOT reset scroll on step change. Add useEffect(() => { scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({y:0, animated:false}); if(Platform.OS==='web') window.scrollTo(0,0); }, [currentStep]).

TravelVisaMain.tsx (or wherever feature-quota-pill lives): Fixed-position overlays that intercept pointer events over interactive content are a UX foot-gun. Either use pointer-events:none on the wrapper and re-enable it on the close button, or coordinate visibility with the onboarding overlay state (hide while onboarding open).

AppShell / TravelVisa route: The Travel Visa page renders outside AppShell (no sidebar). This is an inconsistency vs the rest of the app and removes access to global controls (theme-toggle, notifications) while on this route.

Also observed: /api/auth/me returns 401 during initial bootstrap and 403 on some requests before session_renew_success — these are logged as errors in the browser console for every visit. Not a blocker but noisy in console; consider suppressing to warn.

rca_of_the_issue: BUG #1 (quota-pill intercepts Continue): The feature-quota-pill is rendered as a fixed-positioned overlay in the free-user experience. When the onboarding ScrollView scrolls the Continue button into view at y~1798, the pill (which sits at ~y=830) overlaps the button's tapped coordinate under Playwright's mouse-based clicks (real browsers also route pointerup/pointerdown to topmost element at coord). The pill's subtree intercepts pointer events. Fix: hide the pill while tv-v2-onboarding-overlay is visible OR set pointer-events:none on the pill wrapper. BUG #2 (step-3 blank): The outer window is scrolled to y~782 to bring step-2's Continue button into view. When setCurrentStep('experience') fires, React re-renders the step-3 content but does NOT reset scroll position. The step-3 level cards live at DOM y=628 (top of step-3 content); with scrollTop=780, they render at viewport y = 628 - 782 - header-offset = -452. Fix: add useEffect on currentStep change to reset both the outer window scroll AND the ScrollView's internal scroll position to 0. iter_909's contentContainerStyle change corrected the height computation but did not address the scroll position.
